item.title: CamTran canceling bus services ahead of weekend winter storm
item.description: JOHNSTOWN, Pa. (WTAJ) -- With the impending winter storm predicted to bring snow to the area, causing hazardous conditions, CamTran has announced bus services will be canceled. According to CamTran, no fixed route, ADA paratransit, or shared ride services will operate throughout Sunday, with conditions expected to become dangerous and potentially impact safety for riders.
